say:1:1034109001:0.text: Yes! As the village elder of Taran, I owe you all a great debt of gratitude.
say:1:1034109001:0.source_cn: 是的，我作为塔兰村的村长还欠你们一次感谢。
say:1:1034109001:0.male: Yes! As the village elder of Taran, I owe you all a great debt of gratitude.
say:1:1034109001:0.female: Yes! As the village elder of Taran, I owe you all a great debt of gratitude.

say:2:1034109002:0.text: Thank you for bestowing Hewynn's Dewdrops unto the village. You've saved many lives.
say:2:1034109002:0.source_cn: 感谢你们为塔兰村取来“伊温的露珠”，这解救了很多村民。
say:2:1034109002:0.male: Thank you for bestowing Hewynn's Dewdrops unto the village. You've saved many lives.
say:2:1034109002:0.female: Thank you for bestowing Hewynn's Dewdrops unto the village. You've saved many lives.

say:3:1034109003:0.text: Master Arden also informed me that you defeated the forces of evil to purify the Lucent Tree and save both the Dark Forest and Vaduso.
say:3:1034109003:0.source_cn: 贤者雅顿还告知我，你们击败了邪恶力量净化了流荧树，拯救...
say:3:1034109003:0.male: Master Arden also informed me that you defeated the forces of evil to purify the Lucent Tree and save both the Dark Forest and Vaduso.
say:3:1034109003:0.female: Master Arden also informed me that you defeated the forces of evil to purify the Lucent Tree and save both the Dark Forest and Vaduso.

say:4:1034109004:0.text: I've spread word of your deeds among the villagers. I believe their previous hostility towards you will most certainly subside.
say:4:1034109004:0.source_cn: 我已在塔兰村中传颂你们的事迹，相信之前村子里对你们的敌...
say:4:1034109004:0.male: I've spread word of your deeds among the villagers. I believe their previous hostility towards you will most certainly subside.
say:4:1034109004:0.female: I've spread word of your deeds among the villagers. I believe their previous hostility towards you will most certainly subside.

say:5:1034109005:0.text: We of Taran will forever remember what you've done for us.
say:5:1034109005:0.source_cn: 塔兰村的我们将会永远牢记你们所做的一切。
say:5:1034109005:0.male: We of Taran will forever remember what you've done for us.
say:5:1034109005:0.female: We of Taran will forever remember what you've done for us.

say:6:1034109006:0.text: As long as our river flows freely, you will always be welcome here.
say:6:1034109006:0.source_cn: 只要塔兰河仍在奔腾，塔兰村就会随时欢迎你们。
say:6:1034109006:0.male: As long as our river flows freely, you will always be welcome here.
say:6:1034109006:0.female: As long as our river flows freely, you will always be welcome here.
